sources.title: MobileNet · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MobileNet also employs techniques like channel-wise linear bottleneck layers, which improve model accuracy while reducing the number of parameters. The architecture is designed with optimizations for various hardware platforms, including CPUs, GPUs, and even specialized hardware such as Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs).

sources.title: MobileNet V2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MobileNet V2 improves performance on mobile devices with a more efficient architecture. It uses inverted residual blocks and linear bottlenecks to start with a smaller representation of the data, expands it for processing, and shrinks it again to reduce the number of computations. sources.snippet: The MobileNet model is based on depthwise separable convolutions which is a form of factorized convolutions which factorize a standard convolution into a depthwise convolution and a 1 × 1 $1×1$ convolution called a pointwise convolution. For MobileNets the depthwise convolution applies a single filter to each input channel.
